name: User access provisioning approval
description: All new user access requests require documented line-manager approval before provisioning.

name: Quarterly user access review
description: System owners review and certify all active user accounts quarterly.

name: Privileged access restriction
description: Administrative privileges are restricted to authorized personnel and logged.

name: Change approval board review
description: All production changes are reviewed and approved by the CAB before deployment.

name: Emergency change post-review
description: Emergency changes receive retrospective approval within 5 business days.

name: Segregation of environments
description: Development, test, and production environments are logically separated.

name: Daily backup execution
description: Critical systems are backed up daily and completion is monitored.

name: Annual restore testing
description: Backup restoration is tested at least annually for critical systems.

name: Incident escalation procedure
description: Security incidents are escalated per the documented severity matrix.

name: Incident log completeness
description: All incidents are logged with root cause and resolution details.

name: Encryption at rest
description: Sensitive data stores are encrypted at rest using approved algorithms.

name: Data classification labelling
description: Information assets are classified and labelled per policy.

name: Key management rotation
description: Encryption keys are rotated per the key management standard.

name: Third-party security assessment
description: Critical vendors undergo security assessment before onboarding.

name: Vendor SLA monitoring
description: Vendor service levels are monitored against contractual SLAs.
